fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: How Ledgerly found the real reason month-end ran late

fields.name: body
fields.label: Article
fields.default:
For two years, Ledgerly’s product team believed month-end close ran late because reports were slow to load. They had support tickets, survey scores and a performance dashboard to prove it. So they spent a quarter making reports faster. Close still ran late.

Ten calls in two weeks

In August the team tried something different. They booked ten 30-minute calls with finance leads and recorded every one in Fieldnote. Two people joined each call: one to talk and one to tag highlights as they happened.

By the third call a pattern was clear. Nobody was waiting for reports. They were waiting for each other. Approvals bounced between three people over email, and nobody could see who had the file.

From highlights to a roadmap

The team cut a four-minute reel from the calls and played it at the next planning meeting. Within a week, approval tracking moved to the top of the roadmap.

  • Approvals now happen inside Ledgerly, with a clear owner at each step
  • Finance leads get one reminder a day instead of a dozen emails
  • Average close time dropped from nine days to six

The performance work was not wasted, but it was not the problem. Ten conversations found what two years of tickets had missed.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.default: We had three years of support tickets, and none of them said what one 30-minute call made obvious.
